source: Pew Research Center. 2016. "One-in-Five U.S. Adults Were Raised in Interfaith Homes."
method: Population is current religious tradition (reltrad), among respondents who attend religious services (qd3's own skip pattern) and have a spouse/partner. Share answering "yes" to qd3 ("when you attend religious services, is it typically with your spouse/partner"); don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted (this recontact reached only 5,000 of the main 2014 RLS's 35,071 respondents). Weighted by the dataset's own `rweight` variable.
